meta.name: river_bridge_city
meta.prompt: Two quarters of one city on opposite banks of a wide river — the old walled quarter on the east bank, the new gridded quarter on the west — joined by a single great stone bridge with houses built along its length.

programs.brief: A monumental multi-arched medieval stone bridge spanning east-west across the wide river, joining the east and west city quarters. Sturdy stone piers with pointed cutwaters support massive stone arches carrying a central cobbled roadway lined continuously on both north and south sides with two-to-three storey timber-framed overhanging shops and houses with gables, dormers, and chimney stacks overhanging the water, and stone gate arches at each portal.

tokens.terrain: a wide river flowing north-south dividing the land into an east bank and a west bank
